entity_types: Asociación (Ley sobre Asociaciones y Registro Central de Personas Jurídicas, 1983); fundación (Ley de Fundaciones); fideicomiso (Ley 395/1998).
cost_time: US$300–800; 4–8 weeks if granted. Notary for the public deed adds ~US$100–300; official processing time unpublished; foreigners need no local residence.

entity_types: Asociación (Ley 218 de 1920); fundación sin fines de lucro; fideicomiso — personalidad via Registro de la Propiedad / Ministerio de Educación y Cultura.
cost_time: US$1,000–2,500 incl. notary; 4–8 weeks for registration, tax exemption takes months. Notary fee ~US$300–600; official timelines unpublished.

entity_types: Fundación de interés privado (Ley 25/1995; min endowment US$10,000); asociación; fideicomiso (Ley 10/1994).
cost_time: US$2,500–4,500 incl. notary; ~US$400/yr maintenance; 4–8 weeks. Foreigners may establish a FIP (not barred); official timelines unpublished.

entity_types: Fundación (Ley 793/2002); asociación (Código Civil); corporación (personas jurídicas de derecho privado) — registro ante Cámara de Comercio.
cost_time: US$300–600 incl. lawyer; 2–6 weeks at Cámara de Comercio. Notary for the deed ~US$50–150; official timelines unpublished.

entity_types: Fundación (Ley Orgánica de Fundaciones, 2001); asociación o sociedad civil (Código de Comercio, arts. 158+).
cost_time: US$1,000–3,000 incl. lawyer; 3–6+ months (ministerial approval). Notary extra ~US$100–200; official timelines unpublished; bureaucracy heavy.

entity_types: Fundación; asociación civil; institución de utilidad pública (IUP) — personalidad otorgada por el gobierno (Reglamento 2018).
cost_time: US$500–1,500 incl. lawyer/notary; 2–3 months (Ministerio del Interior). Notary ~US$150–300; official timelines unpublished.

entity_types: Asociación civil (Ley 27258/2000); fundación (Ley 27907/2003); instituto de promoción de desarrollo local — registro en SUNARP / Ministerio de Justicia.
cost_time: US$300–800 incl. lawyer; 2–6 weeks (notary deed + SUNARP registration). Notary ~US$150–250; official timelines unpublished.

entity_types: Fundación; asociación (Ley 351/2013); cooperativa (Ley 2440) — registro de personas jurídicas (Superintendencia de Compañías).
cost_time: US$400–1,000 incl. lawyer/notary; 2–4 months. Notary ~US$100–200; official timelines unpublished.

entity_types: Non-profit company (Companies Act cap. 89:01); friendly society (Friendly Societies Act cap. 36:04); co-operative (Co-operative Societies Act 1984).
cost_time: US$300–800 incl. lawyer; 1–3 months at DCRA. Filing ~US$100–300; official timelines unpublished; foreign nationals may incorporate.

entity_types: Stichting (privaat nut, Dutch-style private foundation via notary deed); vereniging (association); coöperatie (co-operative).
cost_time: US$500–1,500 incl. notary/lawyer; 1–3 months. Notary ~US$200–500; official timelines unpublished; no residence requirement for a stichting.

entity_types: Associação (Código Civil); fundação (Código Civil); OSCIP (Lei 9.790/1999) — registro em cartório de registro civil de pessoas jurídicas.
cost_time: US$500–1,500 incl. lawyer/notary; 2–4 months (cartório + optional CGJ certification). Official timelines unpublished; foreigners may set up.

entity_types: Asociación civil y fundación (Ley 5833/2017 de OSC); cooperativa (Ley 1984/1999) — Registro Administrativo de Personas y Estructuras Jurídicas (Ley 6446/2019).
cost_time: US$300–800 incl. lawyer; 1–3 months (MEF/DGPEJBF). Official timelines unpublished; foreign founders may register with a local representative.

entity_types: Asociación civil (Ley 17.296); fundación (Código Civil) — reconocimiento ante la Dirección General de Registro (DGR).
cost_time: US$200–600 incl. lawyer/notary; 2–6 weeks at DGR. Notary ~US$100–200; official timelines unpublished; foreigners may found.

entity_types: Asociación civil (Ley 23.851); fundación (Ley 27.290/2016 y CCyC arts. 193–224); cooperativa (Ley 20.337) — registro según Ley 26.047.
cost_time: US$200–500 incl. lawyer; 2–6 weeks (registro de personas jurídicas; provincial o federal según jurisdicción). Official timelines unpublished.

entity_types: Asociación (Código Civil); corporación (Ley 20.500/2011); fundación de derecho privado (Ley 20.839/2015) — Registro Nacional de Personas Jurídicas.
cost_time: US$200–500 incl. lawyer; 1–3 weeks at Registro Civil. Official timelines unpublished; foreigners may found with a Chilean representative.

entity_types: Registered charity (Charities Act 1994, Registrar of Charities) on top of a CLG (ACRA), society (Societies Act) or trust; company limited by guarantee.
cost_time: S$315–1,500 (ACRA filing + registered secretary); 1–4 weeks; charity status takes ~1–3 months more. Official timelines published by ACRA/Registrar.

entity_types: Society (Societies Act 1966, Act 832); charitable trust (Trustee Act 1949); company limited by guarantee (Companies Act 2016) — SSM or Registrar of Societies.
cost_time: RM100–2,000 with agent; 2–8 weeks. Society registration fee ~RM500; official timelines unpublished; foreigners need a local secretary/member.

entity_types: Yayasan (foundation, UU 16/2001 as amended by UU 28/2004); perkumpulan (association, KUHPerdata) — AHU online at the Ministry of Law.
cost_time: IDR 5–20M (~US$400–1,600) incl. notary; 1–3 months (SK Kemenkum HAM). Official timelines unpublished; foreign founders need an Indonesian proxy.
